roads.name: Deer Run Trail
words: Sweeping and steady: 11 curves in 4.4 miles.
From 1,101 to 1,425 ft, with 727 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.38 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Mason Avenue
words: Sweeping and steady: 9 curves in 3.2 miles.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
From 1,083 to 1,162 ft, with 341 ft of up and down along the way.
6 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
